import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int h = scanner.nextInt();
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        String binaryString = Integer.toBinaryString(n - 1);
        binaryString = "0".repeat(h - binaryString.length()) + binaryString;
        int totalValue = 0;
        boolean flagState = true;
        for (int positionIndex = 0; positionIndex < h; positionIndex++) {
            char currentChar = binaryString.charAt(positionIndex);
            if (currentChar == (flagState ? '1' : '0')) {
                totalValue += Math.pow(2, h - positionIndex);
            } else {
                flagState = !flagState;
                totalValue += 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(totalValue);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
